title: Cube Reconstruction / color / opposite
description: Fold the six exterior faces and compare the printed markings.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Track an opposite normal across the net.

question: The net is shown from the printed side. Place that side down before folding upward, so the markings face outward. The image shows the net of a small cube with its six faces painted different colors. The net is folded upwards to form the cube. What color is on the face opposite the Blue face? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

options.label: A
options.text: All three other options are incorrect

annotation.Question: The image shows the net of a small cube with its six faces painted different colors. The net is folded upwards to form the cube. What color is on the face opposite the Blue face? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.
Choices: All three other options are incorrect

Explanation.C: Assuming the base is the square in the 2nd row, 1st column of the net, and the right face is the one to the right of the base. Option C is incorrect because it is the Front-Top-Right view mirrored horizontally.
Explanation.A: Assuming the base is the square in the 2nd row, 1st column of the net, and the right face is the one to the right of the base. Option A is incorrect because it is the Front-Top-Left view mirrored horizontally.
Explanation.ABCD: After folding the net, the front face is Green, the back is Blue, the left is Cyan, the right is Pink, the top is Yellow, and the bottom is Red.
Explanation.B: Option B is correct because it shows the Back-Top-Right view.
